meta.label: College Football
meta.devig: power (solve sum(r^k)=1); proportional de-vig leaves longshots too high and favourites too low
meta.consensus: equal-weighted mean of the books' de-vigged log-odds, over POSTED prices only; a spread put through Phi is carried and labelled but does not vote. Inverse-variance weighting waits for graded history
meta.house_effects: each book against the consensus of the OTHER books on the same game (leave-one-out)
